card.fact_statement: Christian Lindner made a public statement regarding the 2025 German federal election.
card.source_span: The FDP party leader Christian Lindner accused the new government of "unrestrained debt creation".

target_qa_variants.question: أي زعيم للحزب الديمقراطي الحر (FDP) أدلى ببيان عام يتهم فيه الحكومة الجديدة بـ "خلق ديون بلا قيود" بعد الانتخابات الاتحادية الألمانية لعام 2025؟
target_qa_variants.source_span: The FDP party leader Christian Lindner accused the new government of "unrestrained debt creation".
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'FDP' to its Arabic equivalent along with the acronym. 'unrestrained debt creation' translated to 'خلق ديون بلا قيود'.

backtranslation_en.question: Which leader of the Free Democratic Party (FDP) made a public statement accusing the new government of "creating unrestricted debt" after the 2025 German federal election?
